label: Restrict the parallel-ray solution classification to an observation panel (inference)
rule: Project each global solution to the panel and realize the ray selections indicated by its live positive readings
meaning: The classification makes activity imply an intact tail and gives each live observation the populated status of its ray. For the converse, select every ray with a live positive reading. Assign all selected rays their intact tails. Cut positions and live agreement then reproduce the whole report, including repeated observations.
